sentences.en: Can you tell me which medication are you taking daily?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你每天在吃哪些药吗？

sentences.en: In my opinion, meditation is more tranquilizing than any medication.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，冥想比任何药物都更能让人平静。

sentences.en: How can I lower my high blood pressure without medication?
sentences.zh: 我能不用吃药就降低高血压吗？

senses.zh: 药物，药剂,药物治疗,药物处理,加入药物

mnemonic: 词根记忆：medic（治疗）+ation→药物治疗
